content:
**Better Criticals** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

The perk has three ranks, each one resulting in progressive amounts of additional damage caused by criticals.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | V.A.T.S. criticals now do +100% damage. | 00065E04 | 
| ★★ | 2 | V.A.T.S. criticals now do +75% damage. | 00065E03 | 
| ★ | 1 | V.A.T.S. criticals now do +50% damage. | 0004D87A | 

This perk only affects V.A.T.S. criticals.
